nodes.title: Debounce search work
nodes.why: The stream waits for a short pause, so rapid keystrokes do not start a search for every valueChanges emission.
nodes.alternative: Run the filter and delayed result pipeline immediately for every keypress.
nodes.tradeoff: Debouncing reduces churn but intentionally delays visible suggestions.

nodes.title: Keep only the latest query stream

anchor.snippet: switchMap((q: string) => (q ? this.search(q) : of([] as string[])))

nodes.why: switchMap unsubscribes from the previous search when a new query passes the debounce. With a 150ms fake search that only happens once search() is slower than the 300ms debounce, as a real request can be, and the stream stays correct then.
nodes.alternative: Merge every pending search and allow older results to arrive after newer input.
nodes.tradeoff: Previous work is abandoned, which is correct for autocomplete but not for operations that must all complete.

nodes.title: Navigate the currently rendered options
nodes.why: Keyboard movement uses the actual option count after filtering and empty-state changes.
nodes.alternative: Navigate against the full city dataset regardless of what is rendered.
nodes.tradeoff: DOM lookup couples navigation to rendered roles, and the first arrow key on a closed list finds no options yet, but activeIndex stays inside the visible list.

nodes.title: Close when interaction leaves the component
nodes.why: The document:mousedown listener from the component's host metadata dismisses suggestions, but not when the press lands inside the autocomplete, such as on an option.
nodes.alternative: Close on every document mousedown, including option selection.
nodes.tradeoff: Containment checking adds DOM awareness, but it preserves mouse selection behavior.

nodes.title: Escape text before adding highlight markup
nodes.why: Suggestion text is escaped before a mark element is introduced, preventing source strings from becoming executable HTML.
nodes.alternative: Interpolate raw suggestion text into an innerHTML highlight string.
nodes.tradeoff: Manual escaping adds code, but it keeps highlighted output safe.

nodes.title: Read the results through a signal
nodes.why: toSignal subscribes once and exposes the latest suggestions as results(); it stays undefined until the first debounced value, which @if (results(); as list) treats the way it treated the async pipe's null.
nodes.alternative: The async pipe with a CommonModule or AsyncPipe import, or a manual subscribe that writes a field.
nodes.tradeoff: The subscription starts when the component is created rather than at first render, and it ends with the component without extra cleanup code.

nodes.title: Drive the search from the FormControl
nodes.why: Typing through [formControl] and select() through setValue both emit valueChanges, so one stream sees every query and no separate Subject has to be kept in sync.
nodes.alternative: A Subject fed from an (input) handler and from select(), which repeats what the FormControl already reports.
nodes.tradeoff: Picks reach the stream too, so the tap needs the pickedValue check to keep a picked city from reopening the list.
